questions.text: What is mini-max algorithm? Explain how alpha-beta pruning enhances its performance in adversial search.

marking_scheme.point: Defines Mini-Max as a recursive algorithm for two-player zero-sum games, identifying MAX and MIN players.
Explains how Mini-Max evaluates terminal states and propagates values up the tree (MAX player picks highest, MIN player picks lowest).
Defines Alpha ($\alpha$) as the best (highest) value MAX player can guarantee so far on the path to the root.
Defines Beta ($\beta$) as the best (lowest) value MIN player can guarantee so far on the path to the root.
Explains the pruning condition ($\alpha \ge \beta$) and how it avoids exploring branches that will not be chosen by an optimal opponent, thus enhancing performance.
